lens: responsive task completion, reachability, focus, assistive semantics, motion preference, and constrained-layout state truth

findings.criterion: Native zoom and manual screen-reader proof
findings.observation: The production 390px journey now contains the long English/Chinese correction, URL, and unbroken token without horizontal overflow. Keyboard order, source focus, reduced motion, and stable light/dark axe scans are direct. The connected normal Chrome page timed out before native 200% zoom, and no screen reader was run.
findings.user_impact: Narrow-browser behavior is materially safer, while users relying on native zoom or spoken traversal could still encounter an unobserved defect.
findings.recommendation: Run native 200% zoom and a manual VoiceOver or NVDA traversal against the same backend-owned states.
findings.verification: The source, four fact decisions, approval, unknown result, reconciliation, cancellation, and retry remain ordered, focusable, and truthfully announced without horizontal scrolling.

findings.observation: Stable light and dark axe scans reported zero WCAG A/AA violations, but grayscale, increased contrast, and reduced transparency were not manually exercised.
findings.user_impact: The captured states are legible in normal themes, while preference-specific state distinction remains inferred.
findings.recommendation: Review the full state matrix in grayscale, increased contrast, and reduced transparency.
findings.verification: Every state label, focus indicator, warning, and verified readback remains distinct without relying on color.

strengths: The long mixed-language correction reflows from a measured 1675px document width to exactly 390px.
Repeated exact-source links now programmatically focus and reopen the source figure.
Cancellation, repeated offline retry, restart recovery, stale approval, unknown result, and reconciliation are directly captured at 390px.
Reduced-motion emulation removes named animation and keeps the verified composition usable.
missing_evidence: Manual VoiceOver, NVDA, or JAWS traversal.
Manual grayscale, increased-contrast, and reduced-transparency review.
open_questions: Does the same calm hierarchy survive native 200% zoom once connected Chrome control is available?
